title: Safety
holdToTextFromPhone: Hold to text your contacts from this phone
sosHoldHint: Hold for a second and a half to alert your trusted contacts with your location.
sosConfirmBody: Your trusted contacts get a text with your live location straight away.

sosOfflineHint: You're offline. SOS will open your messages app so you can text your contacts from this phone.
sosDuringSession: Need help now? Hold SOS to alert everyone.
checkInCardBody: Set a time. If you don't tap I'm safe by then, your contacts get an alert.
shareCardBody: Live, with the people you choose, until you stop or the time runs out.
checkInExplain: Nobody is told anything unless you miss your check-in time. We'll remind you five minutes before.
shareExplain: The people you choose get a text with a link to follow your location live. Nothing is wrong: it's for the way home.
checkInPreview: {count, plural, one {We'll ask at {time}. If you don't answer by {alertTime}, your trusted contact gets an alert with your location.} other {We'll ask at {time}. If you don't answer by {alertTime}, your # trusted contacts get an alert with your location.}}
sharePreview: Sharing ends at {time}. You can stop earlier.
noteHint: Where you are, who you're with, how you're getting home.
notePlaceholder: Near the main stage with Esi
checkInStarted: Check-in set. We'll remind you before the time.
shareStarted: Your contacts can now follow your location.
couldNotStart: That couldn't be started. Try again.
couldNotSave: That couldn't be saved. Try again.
networkError: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

active.alertTitle: Your trusted contacts have been alerted
active.missedTitle: You didn't check in, so your contacts were alerted
active.locationOff: Location is off. Your contacts can't see where you are.
active.checkInQuiet: Nobody has been told. If you miss the time, your contacts get an alert.
active.locationWaitingWeb: Your browser will ask to share your location. Allow it so your contacts can see where you are.

textFromPhoneToo: Also text them from your phone
tellEventTeamBody: The organizer gets your name, phone number, note and location, so their staff can find you.
eventTeamTold: The event team has been told.
addNote: Add a note for your contacts
toldSafe: Your contacts have been told you're safe.
toldMistake: Your contacts have been told it was a mistake.
confirmSafeBody: Everyone who was alerted gets a message that you're safe, and they can no longer see where you are.
confirmMistakeTitle: Tell your contacts it was a mistake?
confirmMistakeBody: Everyone who was alerted gets a message that it was sent by mistake.

notEmergencyServices: SOS alerts your trusted contacts. Abonten does not contact the police, an ambulance or any emergency service. In danger, call the emergency number.
setupBody: Before you need it: add the people Abonten should alert, so one press is enough.
notAvailableYet: Safety isn't available on your account yet.

howItWorksSos: SOS texts your trusted contacts a link to a live map, your note and the event you're at. They can tell you they're on the way.
howItWorksCheckIn: Check-ins and shares end by themselves. If you miss a check-in, the alert goes out for you.
howItWorksPrivacy: Your location is shared only while one of these is running, and never once you say you're safe.
savedOnPhone: Your contacts were saved on this phone {when}, so SOS works offline.
offlineBody: SOS will open your messages app with your location, addressed to your trusted contacts.
offlineSentBody: Send the text from your messages app. We'll also send the alert from Abonten as soon as you're back online.

reminder.soonBody: Open Abonten and tap I'm safe, or add more time.
reminder.nowBody: Tap I'm safe now, or your trusted contacts will be alerted in a few minutes.

deviceSms.withLocation: SOS: I need help. My location: {link} (sent from Abonten)
deviceSms.withoutLocation: SOS: I need help. Please call me. (sent from Abonten)

sosHoldHintWeb: Hold the button, or the space bar, for a second and a half to alert your trusted contacts. Press Enter to be asked first.
addFirstContactBelow: Then add a trusted contact below.
webIntro: Alert the people you trust, ask them to check in on you, or share your live location for the night.
appIsBetter: On a phone, the Abonten app works best: it keeps sending your location on every screen and still works with no internet.
inviteHeading: {person} added you as an emergency contact
inviteBody: Hello {name}. {person} uses Abonten for nights out and would like you to be told if {person} ever needs help.
inviteWhat1: If {person} presses SOS, or misses a check-in, you get a text with a link to see where {person} is.
inviteWhat2: You can answer from that page, so {person} knows you saw it.
inviteWhat3: Abonten never shares your number with anyone else, and you can stop at any time from this page.
inviteAccepted: Thank you. You'll be told if {person} needs help.
inviteBlockedAll: Abonten Safety won't text this number for anyone.
acceptLiftsBlock: This number asked not to get Abonten Safety texts. Accepting turns them back on.
blockAll: Stop all Abonten Safety texts to this number
blockAllBody: Nobody will be able to add this number as an emergency contact, and you won't get any alert texts.
